Overview

Snow Reaper (Final) is a Secret unit. They can only be obtained by evolving Snow Reaper (War).

Evolving

Snow Reaper (Final) can be evolved from Snow Reaper (War) with the following materials:

Why do I have different stats?
Units in this game use a randomized system, where stats like damage are randomly rolled with about a 10% variance (like Dungeon Quest items). When you evolve a unit they also reroll their stats, but it will always be strictly better than the pre-evolved version.

Active Ability: Gale of the Moon

On placement Snow Reaper (Final) obtains a bar which fills up by 1.25 every half second, maxing out at 100.

At Upgrade 1, Snow Reaper (Final) unlocks the ability Gale of the Moon. While this ability is active, the bar will be drained by 2.5 every half second, enemies within her range are slowed, take 1/6th of her damage every half second and are inflicted with Chilled. Chilled enemies have an icon of a snowflake that freezes the enemy and deals an additional hit equal to her damage stat once it reaches 6.

Pressing the ability again will deactivate it manually, or it will automatically deactivate if the bar reach to 0.

Selling

Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

Trivia

  • The snowflake icon disappears after 2 seconds.
  • Her ability counts as full AOE.
  • If you wait for her ability to be at 100% and then let it drain till 0% she would have an additional dps of about 4.9k
